hook: Krishna Kanth Park's lake is set to grow from *3 to 12 acres*
hook_b: Krishna Kanth Park's lake is set to grow from *3 to 12 acres*
tldr: On Sunday, walkers at Krishna Kanth Park in Yousufguda raised sanitation, wall and gym issues with HYDRAA chief A.V. Ranganath as he reviewed the Rs 7.5 crore lake expansion.

beats.what: Citizens asked for a boundary wall on the south side to block an adjoining garbage dumping yard, plus repairs to broken open-air gym equipment.
beats.why: In October HYDRAA launched a Rs 7.5 crore plan to expand the park's lake from three acres to 12, with walking paths, a gym and boating.
beats.care: Rainwater from Jubilee Hills and Venkatagiri is to be channelled into the pond, aimed at preventing flooding in Krishna Nagar, Yousufguda, Madhura Nagar, Srinivas Nagar, Ameerpet and Maitrivanam.
